name: CodeAncestry
tagline: Explains undocumented legacy code at several levels so the 'why' survives after its authors leave.
problem: Developers spend much of their time reverse-engineering decisions in undocumented codebases.
solution: Connects a GitHub repo, embeds it in a data platform, and generates layered explanations with an LLM, behind secure authentication.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a legacy file and read why it was written that way.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Warp] Best Developer Tool” and “[MLH] Best Use of Snowflake API” among 169 submissions.
Won the developer-tool prize and a data-platform prize with one build.

lessons: Stack sponsors that naturally fit one pipeline.
